'''Minister of Homeworld Security''' was a position in the government of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] of [[N'zoth]] that was held by [[Zorbazat Xong]]. Xong's powers as Minister allowed him to instigate searches of [[Starship/Legends|ships]], require that customs sheets be redone, call in security forces, and have suspects followed.<ref name="CatCW" />
